title: Depth/width sweep toward smaller model (DEPTH=6)
description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 6 (model_dim 384, 3 heads), all else unchanged
reflection: val_bpb 1.063457, clearly worse than baseline 1.014027. More optimizer steps on a smaller/narrower model did NOT compensate for reduced per-step capacity within the fixed 5-min budget. This is a useful negative result that brackets the depth search space in the opposite direction from every other proposal this round (all of which go deeper, DEPTH=10-12) -- it suggests the compute-optimal point for this budget is at or above DEPTH=8, not below.
